Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way. With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination. You as part of tonies: We're looking for an experienced Graphic/Visual Designer to own the design output of the tonies Accessories portfolio. You'll work within a structured product development process (PDP), holding the Responsible role across various design tasks — from initial ideation through to golden sample approval. This is a role for someone who thinks in finished products that excite our target audiences, not just finished files. You understand that what you're designing will be held by a child, sitting on a shelf in a retailer in Germany, the US, or the UK, next to one of the most loved children's brands in the world. That context matters to you. This role may NOT be a great fit if: Your background is primarily in UI/UX, Web, or Digital Product Design. Your experience is strictly in Hardlines or Industrial Hardware Design (e.g., plastic toys, consumer electronics, or pure hardware). You have no experience designing physical products aimed at kids, families, or youth lifestyle audiences. Your focus has been on managing external creative agencies or vendor design teams, rather than personally creating hands-on 2D production-ready artwork. Your tasks and responsibilities will include: Design ownership across the full PDP Direct CMF (Color, Material, Finish) for all accessories categories — Headphones, Nightlights, Bags, Shelves, Decoration, and more. Build design briefs for ODM/OEM manufacturing partners and own the construction sample process Lead first sample and golden sample approvals against brand and CMF standards Manage Top of Production (TOP) sample reviews and sign-off Commission 3D packaging renders from supply partners and review against brand Licensor management Own the end-to-end licensor design submission process for all IP partnerships Maintain the licensor submission tracker and ensure approvals stay on schedule Build fluency with individual licensor style guides and maintain their application across the range Brand stewardship Own and maintain the Accessories Style Guides — the definitive brand reference for all categories Ensure visual coherence across all accessories SKUs (across our entry, mid and premium tiers) in the annual pipeline with a distinctive connection with the broader tonies product ecosystem Maintain and organise shared drive documentation (samples, approvals, asset files, product catalogue) Work closely with external agencies and the brand creative teams to ensure alignment and brand integrity Cross-functional collaboration Present design routes and options to Senior Product Managers who set commercial direction Work in lockstep with the Senior Operations Lead on sample logistics, scheduling, and PDP coordination Translate commercial briefs into executable design direction for manufacturing partners including our preferred outsourced operations partner. What we are looking for: 5–7 years of product design, graphic/visual design or packaging design experience in consumer goods, accessories, lifestyle, or licensed products essential Proven CMF direction experience across multiple product categories Hands-on experience managing licensor approval loops with brand partners (entertainment, character, lifestyle IP) Experience working with ODM/OEM supply chains — you know what a design brief needs to include for a manufacturer to execute it Familiarity with a structured product development process (stage-gate, RACI-based, or similar) Advanced Adobe Creative Suite proficiency (Illustrator, Photoshop) including production-ready artwork Strong understanding of material and print processes — what a spec sheet needs to say, and why English at a professional level; German is a strong plus You must be able to work hybrid from one of our offices: Dusseldorf, Berlin, Schwäbisch Gmünd or London. description:
Who We Are:

Gram Games is the studio behind popular titles like 1010!, Six!, Merge Dragons!, and Merge Magic!, with more exciting projects in the pipeline. We are proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We do things differently here: we work in small self-managing teams, giving you an incredible amount of ownership, autonomy, and impact. 

At Gram, everyone is expected to have a razor-sharp focus on creating a tangible impact on their team, their work environment, and on the overall company strategy. If you are motivated by autonomy, constant improvement, collaboration, and a sense of belonging, this is the place for you.

We are looking for an ASO & Partnerships leader to drive organic growth and deepen platform relationships for Merge Dragons, Monster Legends, Dragon City, FarmVille titles and many more. This role owns the studio's app store optimization strategy end-to-end and serves as our primary relationship holder with the major app store platforms — Google Play, the Apple App Store, Microsoft Store and Amazon Appstore.

You will lead a team responsible for improving organic visibility, store conversion, and featuring, while working closely with Product, Creative, UA, and Data teams to unlock sustainable organic growth and strengthen the top of the funnel. You will mentor and empower the ASO team to deliver best-in-class execution, and you'll be the studio's trusted voice in front of our platform partners.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end ASO strategy for the portfolio, driving organic installs, store conversion, and keyword/category rankings across all markets.
  • Define and manage the yearly organic growth roadmap, including localization, seasonal, and launch strategies.
  • Set the studio's platform partnership strategy, aligning featuring and promotional opportunities with business priorities and release calendars.

Platform Partnerships

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with Google Play, Apple App Store, Microsoft Store, and Amazon Appstore partner teams.
  • Secure featuring, editorial placements, and promotional opportunities across launches, updates, and key seasonal moments.
  • Advocate for early access to platform betas, new store features, monetization tools, and APIs, and channel those opportunities back to Product and UA.
  • Represent the studio in partner reviews, QBRs, and industry events, and negotiate co-marketing and joint business plans.

Performance Optimization

  • Lead store listing experimentation (Custom Product Pages, Product Page Optimization, Google Play store listing experiments) to improve conversion rate.
  • Own keyword and metadata optimization, and build rigorous test roadmaps across icons, screenshots, preview videos, and descriptions.
  • Establish measurement frameworks to attribute organic uplift and quantify the impact of ASO and featuring initiatives.

Team & Collaboration

  • Mentor ASO managers, specialists, and analysts; build structured career growth and execution excellence.
  • Partner closely with Creative teams to fuel store asset testing velocity and creative breakthroughs.
  • Collaborate with UA, Product, and Data teams to ensure cohesive full-funnel optimization and visibility improvements.

Operational Excellence

  • Establish clear accountability for results with transparent reporting and actionable insights.
  • Improve execution speed through better process, prioritization, and cross-team alignment.

Qualifications

  • 6–10+ years of ASO or mobile organic growth experience in free-to-play, ideally in gaming.
  • Proven track record of improving organic installs and store conversion at scale across multiple markets.
  • Established working relationships with platform partner teams (Apple, Google, and ideally Microsoft and/or Amazon).
  • Strong fluency in ASO tools (e.g. AppTweak, Sensor Tower, data.ai) and store listing A/B testing methodologies.
  • Deep understanding of app store algorithms, ranking factors, and each platform's merchandising ecosystem.
  • Experience leading and developing high-performing teams.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across multiple functions.
  • Bonus: familiarity with Match-3/puzzle models and hybrid-casual or builder games.

Keep the bid library current: standard answers, case studies, evidence, policies and certifications. Run post-bid reviews, collect evaluator feedback and use it to lift our win rate. Work with the delivery team to track the social value commitments we make once a contract is awarded. Improve how we bid, including the AI tools and workflows we already use to draft and review answers. Working knowledge of UK public procurement, including the Procurement Act 2023, the Provider Selection Regime, frameworks and dynamic markets. Experience beyond the NHS, such as local authorities, central government, devolved administrations, or private and independent sector buyers. Excellent writing. You can make a complex answer short, clear and compliant, and we’ll ask you to show us. Strong project management. You can run several bids at once, hold people to deadlines and stay calm the night before a noon submission. Confidence working with senior clinical, technical and commercial stakeholders, and challenging them when an answer isn’t good enough yet. Commercial judgement about which bids are worth pursuing, and the confidence to recommend a no-bid. Comfort in a fast-paced scale-up and genuine enthusiasm for using AI in your own work. description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The Chief of Staff is part of the senior leadership team of the Vinted-wide Data Science & Analytics function. Your primary role will be to build an aligned, engaged, and impactful team while ensuring the successful management and execution of key data strategies and initiatives. The Chief of Staff reports directly to the Vice President of Data Science & Analytics (“VP of DSA”) and acts as a trusted advisor and partner in ensuring that the department runs smoothly, efficiently, and effectively.

This is a fixed-term (maternity cover) position for approximately 1 year.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the VP of DSA, providing advice and guidance on all matters within the function (e.g. operating cadence, planning, problem analysis, communication). 
  • Own and run the function’s reporting cycles end-to-end (e.g. QBRs, OKR meetings, DSA All Hands); including content creation, preparation, facilitation, and follow-ups.
  • Be responsible for coordinating the development and driving the execution of key function strategies and initiatives  (e.g. data related initiatives that drive long-term impact), and supporting broader cross-functional and organisational initiatives that involve DSA (e.g. reorganisations and operating model shifts).
  • Oversee and manage recurrent DSA operations (e.g. DSA’s onboarding programme as well as the Data Science & Analytics Academy programme).
  • Own the delivery of key functional events, including planning groups and agenda development (e.g. offsites, function week).
  • Be accountable for maintaining an efficient operating model by ensuring processes, policies, and ceremonies are in place and effective, fostering an aligned, engaged, and impactful team.
  • Support the DSA leadership team on the integration of AI into our data team’s (300+ team members) workflows.
  • Be the driving force behind the senior and extended DSA leadership teams; coordinating and managing meetings, keeping track of decisions and pending relevant actions, holding the group accountable, and ensuring follow-through.
  • (Co-) author key documents on function-related topics, ranging from vision and strategy papers to process and standards documentation, based on high-level instructions and discussions with the team and stakeholders.
  • Conduct research and analysis on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies related to the function, and provide recommendations to the DSA leadership team.
  • Own the organisation and documentation of the function’s governance (e.g., Google Groups, Drive, Confluence spaces, Slack Channels).

About you 

  • Significant experience in strategy, consulting, or strategic transformation roles, with a track record of success in project management, management engagement, and strategic planning.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to break complex initiatives and challenges into manageable deliverables.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously.
  • Proven leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively and build relationships across all levels of the organisation.
  • Strong facilitation and moderation skills, with experience designing and leading workshops to discuss strategic priorities, build alignment, and drive decision-making.
  • Comfortable interpreting aggregate (analytical) data and turning it into actional conclusions – but advanced data analysis skills are not required.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands on and detail-oriented problem solver, able to identify operational gaps and inefficiencies.
  • Adaptable and comfortable operating under ambiguity, with the ability to pivot quickly, reprioritise effectively, and respond to emerging challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per your workday
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
  • Supplemental Private Health Insurance
  • Life and Disability insurance
  • A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:
€83.300—€112.700 EUR

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.

As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

London, United Kingdom or Switzerland (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office in London or Zurich)

You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?

  • Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.
  • Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.
  • Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.
  • Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.
  • Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.

About the opportunity

We’re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.

You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.

Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.

How you will make an impact

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.
  • Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.
  • Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.
  • Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.
  • Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.
  • Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.
  • Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.

What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.
  • Business-fluent German: you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in German. 
  • Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.
  • Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.
  • Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.
  • Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.
  • Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.
  • Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.
  • Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.

Working model

Working hours are generally 9:00am-6:00pm London time, providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.

You’ll typically spend:

  • Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.
  • Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.
  • Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.

Initially this role will be remote from London. Once Pallet opens its London office, you’ll work from the office five days per week whenever you’re not traveling to customers.

Reporting structure

You’ll report directly to the General Manager, London for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion.

You’ll also work closely with our Head of Sales, participating in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.

Interview Process

  • Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins
  • Deal Review - 30 mins
  • Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins
  • Final Interview - ~3 hours
  • Brief Background Check and Reference Check

We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.

Compensation

The estimated compensation range for this role is £100,000-£240,000 OTE, depending on experience and skill set.

Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. High performers are eligible for uncapped commission accelerators above quota.

In addition to cash compensation, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and significant growth opportunities as one of our earliest international commercial hires.

Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated enterprise sales performance.

 

Our Benefits 

We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.

  • 🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits 
  • 🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation
  • ➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance 
  • ❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage
  • 💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff
  • 🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future
  • 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families
  • 📚 Yearly learning and development stipend
  • 🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area employees
  • 🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office 
  • 🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space
  • 🍔 Daily catered lunches provided 
  • ✈️ Onboarding trip to San Francisco HQ if you work remotely
  • 🥤 Monthly happy hours
  • 🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴

Workplace Policy

We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.

Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip. 

Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.

Equal Opportunity

Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.

Candidate Privacy Notice

Please review Pallet’s Candidate Privacy Notice here.

Accommodations

Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with a disability during the application process and throughout employment as required by law.

Nicht als Aushilfe, sondern als der Mensch, der Dinge übernimmt und dann selbst besser macht. Was du machst Dein erstes großes Projekt suchst du dir selbst aus. Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire. Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024. Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde. Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse ! description: Intelance helps organisations make clear, evidence based decisions about technology. We are looking for a freelance Lead Enterprise Architect to run a fixed scope enterprise architecture review for a large UK professional services firm, and to stay on as the firm’s interim architect if the client takes the follow on work. You will lead the work day to day. Intelance’s engagement partner stays accountable for the engagement and the client relationship. The review runs over four to six weeks from November 2026 and needs around 18 days. The optional follow on is two days a week for eight weeks, then a short check around 90 days after the review, finishing around early March 2027. The work is mainly remote within the UK, with some days at client offices in England agreed in advance. Tasks Lead the review from the first meeting to the final presentation, as the client’s day to day contact. Start from the records the client already keeps, such as integration documents, system lists and project records. Run eight to ten one hour conversations with the heads of applications, IT operations, data, client solutions and the project office. Build one clear picture of the whole technology estate: systems, connections, data flows and owners. Trace two or three recent technology decisions from the first request to the current owner. Write a priority risk report and three costed options for how the firm should own technology decisions, always including keeping its current model. Present the findings and options to the Chief Operating Officer with Intelance’s engagement partner. If the follow on goes ahead, act as the firm’s interim architect two days a week. Set up a technology decision forum, prepare the first three decisions for it and hand over the estate map as a working tool. Requirements Experience as a lead or head of enterprise architecture in a UK law firm, or in another professional services partnership of around 1,000 people or more. You have set up an architecture function, design authority or technology decision forum from scratch. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform. Knowledge of Aderant, InterAction or legal document management systems is a strong plus. You write costed options papers yourself and present them with confidence to a Chief Operating Officer or board. You work well alongside capable internal teams and build on what they already have. Independent of software vendors. You must not currently work for, or resell products from, a legal software supplier, a Microsoft partner or an IT services provider to the client. Available from early November 2026 to early March 2027, at three to four days a week during the review. Based in the UK with the right to work here, and willing to complete the background checks the client requires. Benefits £750 to £850 per day, depending on relevant experience. Rates exclude VAT where applicable. Contracting route and tax status are confirmed before work starts. Around 18 days for the review, plus around 16 days and a day 90 check if the follow on goes ahead. A defined scope, clear outputs and Intelance templates, so your time goes on the work itself. Direct work with Intelance’s engagement partner, with a Data and AI Architect alongside you. The possibility of an ongoing part time architect role with the same client, by mutual agreement. No minimum volume of work is guaranteed. Apply with your CV and answer the short screening questions. No cover letter is needed. Shortlisted candidates will join a working session with our engagement partner to talk through how they would run the review. The work starts once the client confirms the engagement. We will agree availability, rate and contract terms in writing before then. Please do not include confidential client documents. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. We are looking for an experienced Data Analytics Engineer to join our growing Tax Data Mart team. This role will be a key contributor to the team and will be responsible for building the tax data operations function for our Deliveroo and Wolt legal entities. This includes building and operating the data pipelines and infrastructure that power tax analytics and support decision-making across the company. As DoorDash continues to grow its global footprint across multiple business lines, we are looking for a candidate with experience working with Tax teams to gather requirements, and designing scalable data processes to support them.. This person will grow our unique community via your blend of tax, data technology, and process improvement experience. About the Role You will be reporting to the Senior Manager of Tax Data & Operations, and play an integral role in DoorDash's data function, owning the processes for ingesting, transforming, and controlling our data, ensuring accuracy, and making it available to analytics and business users. As a member of this team, you will lead the design, implementation, and operation of data pipelines and related processes to support the Company's exponential growth. What you'll be doing Lead the collection of Tax Data and Reporting requirements through close relationships with Tax team counterparts Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines (ETL/ELT) that serve data across the company Develop and optimize data models and warehouse structures to support analytics and reporting Participate in new business initiatives and identify their impact on existing data system(s) and processes. Work closely with Analytics, Data Science, and business partners in the development and validation of new data sources. Identify and document business, functional and technical requirements to support new business initiatives and to enhance existing system functionality. Leverage AI & AI assisted tooling to build and automate recurring data tasks & pipelines. Monitor data quality, reliability, and observability, and resolve data-related issues for our internal business partners. Participate in defining the Company's data tooling needs, including the maintenance of existing systems. Prepare documentation related to our data systems and processes. Share knowledge and best practices with engineers and analysts across the team. Our humble expectations You have 7+ years of experience in a Tax data & technology or similar role. Experience using Data Build Tool (DBT) or a similar product to manage data flows. Experience using Claude, Cursor and similar AI tools. You are an expert at using SQL with experience using Snowflake. Proficiency in Python (or a comparable language) for building data pipelines. Experience with modern data stack and orchestration tools such as Airflow, Spark, or Kafka. You have strong attention to detail and analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. You're an independently motivated person with a proven ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize work independently. You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. Project management experience, including creation of project plans, milestones, and due dates. Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related degree. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. description: About Ledger We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger. At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries. The team: You're joining as we reshape the People & Operations Experience team, which brings together ops, payroll, people tech, engagement and internal comms. That makes this a build-and-run role. You'll run payroll from day one and help design how the function works going forward, from processes to tooling to documentation. The role You'll take ownership of French payroll, starting with a proper handover from the colleague who runs it today and building towards running it independently. Alongside it, you'll look after the employee lifecycle: joiners, leavers and everything in between. It's real responsibility, with a team around you. Your development goes in two directions: continuous improvement of how People Ops works, and a progressive move into Global Payroll (US, UK, Singapore) as your confidence and scope grow. Your arrival also creates room for the whole team to take on bigger things, and that includes you. What you'll do Own French payroll Run the full monthly cycle: data collection, absences and leave, inputs, controls, validation and payslip checks Prepare and submit statutory filings on time (URSSAF, DSN, IJSS/Net-entreprise and other mandatory declarations) Manage variable pay and contractual changes, and build the VPI file for ADP Decidium Work with Finance on transfer files, cost reporting, headcount tracking and variance analysis Handle day to day equity payroll declarations (stock options / BSPCE) as you slowly build your expertise Manage benefits, meal vouchers and provider relationships Track regulatory changes and turn them into better processes Run the employee lifecycle Handle joiners and leavers: contracts, health insurance and transport registration, visa and absence data Keep Workday data accurate and compliant Help document and improve the processes being rebuilt, and contribute to cross-functional People projects You'll work with Finance, Talent Acquisition, HRBPs, C&B and our provider ADP. What you bring 2–3 years of French payroll experience, with hands-on exposure to the monthly cycle and a readiness to own it Solid knowledge of French social legislation (URSSAF, DSN) and experience with a payroll tool (ADP or similar) Rigour: you close the month on time, without being chased A builder's instinct: you document as you go and like making things work better Comfort working in English in a multicultural team Curiosity about international payroll and a real appetite to widen your scope At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to: Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance. Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work. Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation. Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee. For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information. We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: SpAItial is building world models that understand and generate 3D environments. Our work brings together generative AI, computer vision and graphics, with potential applications across robotics, entertainment and spatial computing. We’re looking for a People & Talent Manager to help us build an exceptional team and a company where that team can do its best work. Recruiting will be your first priority. You’ll personally lead searches for researchers and engineers, including people with PhDs and postdoctoral experience, and help our founders make excellent hiring decisions. You’ll also own and develop our people, HR and culture processes as we grow across London and Munich. This is a hands-on role with considerable scope. You’ll join the Operations team and have the opportunity to shape the people function from an early stage. Responsibilities Own hiring from role definition to accepted offer, initially focusing on research, machine learning, engineering and other highly technical roles. Find and engage researchers and engineers through direct sourcing, referrals, academic networks, research conferences and industry communities. Partner with founders and hiring managers to understand specialist work, define what success looks like and assess candidates consistently. Give candidates clear communication and a thoughtful experience throughout the process. Own the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, people records and the processes that support employees day to day. Develop practical approaches to performance, feedback, development and manager support as the team grows. Help build a strong culture across our London and Munich teams. Maintain clear people policies and processes, working with Operations and local advisers where specialist employment guidance is needed. Use hiring and people data to identify problems, improve processes and help the leadership team plan ahead. Key qualifications 4+ years of experience in talent acquisition, people operations or a related role, with a strong record of personally recruiting for tech teams. Demonstrated experience sourcing and hiring PhD level researchers, postdoctoral researchers or research scientists, alongside highly specialised engineers. The ability to understand research profiles, publications and technical career paths well enough to engage credible candidates and earn hiring managers’ trust. Experience owning or building people processes beyond hiring, such as onboarding, performance, employee development or HR operations. Sound judgment, discretion and empathy when handling sensitive people matters. Strong organisation and follow-through: you can manage several searches and people priorities without losing detail. A practical, proactive approach to building processes that work for a growing company. Nice to have Experience hiring in machine learning, computer vision, graphics, robotics or related fields. Relationships with relevant universities, research labs or deep tech communities. Experience in an early-stage or rapidly growing technology company. Experience supporting teams across both the UK and Germany. At SpAItial, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Our Commerce & Technology division helps leading global brands design, build and run the commerce platforms behind their growth. We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect to lead solution in business pursuits and account growth, across enterprise commerce. 

You will be the person in the room who understands how the whole commerce estate fits together, from web storefront and mobile app through commerce platform, data and ERP.   You will turn that understanding into a clear case for business value, win the trust of senior client stakeholders, and when it helps, build a working demonstration to show them what good looks like. 
 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Architect Enterprise Commerce: Design end to end commerce solutions across Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify, HCL and composable (MACH) solutions, spanning web, mobile apps, data and back office systems.  
  • Lead with value: Frame every solution around commercial outcomes, cost and return, so clients can see clear cases for change rather than a technology shopping list.  
  • Serve as an outward-facing, energetic leader who runs workshops, participates in governance, and collaborates with commercial teams to identify and shape technical growth opportunities. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Client Engagement and Discovery: Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders. Run discovery workshops, ask the questions that uncover what really matters, and cut through complexity to the decisions that count. 
  • Solution Design and Architecture: Produce clear architecture diagrams and solution designs covering storefront, mobile apps, commerce platform, search, content, order management, product information, payments, data and other integrations. Recommend the right platform and approach for each client rather than defaulting to one. 
  • Platform Selection and Replatforming: Guide clients through platform choices and migrations, including the move from monolithic to composable, weighing total cost of ownership, speed to market, risk and operating model. 
  • Data, Integration and Back Office: Get into the detail of how commerce connects to ERP (such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Oracle), order management, warehouse, customer data and analytics, and design integration patterns that hold up at enterprise scale. 
  • Mobile and Omnichannel: Shape mobile app strategy and architecture (native, cross platform and headless) alongside web, store and marketplace channels, so the customer experience is joined up. 
  • Business Case and Value: Build business cases, value models and roadmaps that link technology decisions to revenue, conversion, margin and cost to serve. 
  • Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept: Stand up demo storefronts and prototypes quickly, such as a Shopify store or a composable proof of concept, to show clients what is possible and take risk out of their decisions. 
  • Proposals and Pitches: Own the solution story, architecture, assumptions and effort estimates in proposals, and present them with confidence at pitch. 
  • Handover and Delivery Assurance: Make sure what is sold can be delivered, with a clean handover to delivery teams and continued involvement through mobilisation. 
  • Market and Partner Leadership: Stay across the commerce market, including cloud (AWS, GCP), AI in commerce and agentic commerce. Share that knowledge to strengthen our propositions and our partner relationships. 

What we want from you 

  • Enterprise Commerce Experience: Extensive senior experience in enterprise commerce across retail, consumer brands or B2B, gained in digital agencies, consultancies or large brands. 
  • Breadth Across Platforms: Strong working knowledge of Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Shopify, plus composable and MACH (microservices, API first, cloud native, headless) components such as Commerce tools, Contentful, Algolia, Akeneo or similar. 
  • Presales and New Business: A track record of shaping and winning significant commerce deals, running workshops, writing proposals and presenting to senior audiences. 
  • Commercial Acumen: Understands how clients make money. Speaks confidently about value, cost and return, and can hold a commercial conversation with a Chief Executive or Chief Financial Officer as easily as with a Chief Technology Officer. 
  • Data and ERP Integration: Hands on understanding of how commerce connects with ERP, order management, product information, customer data and analytics, and the integration patterns that make it work. 
  • Mobile Apps: Solid understanding of mobile commerce app architecture and delivery, including native and cross platform approaches and how apps connect to headless commerce services. 
  • Architecture and Communication: Excellent diagramming, written and verbal skills. Able to turn complex estates into simple pictures and clear stories for senior audiences. 
  • Hands On Credibility: Comfortable building a demo store, configuring a platform or proving a concept yourself, rather than relying on slides alone. 
  • Presence: Energetic, confident and credible with clients. Able to cut through noise and lead the room. 

If you know some of this, even better 

  • Certifications across Adobe Commerce, Salesforce B2C Commerce or Shopify, MACH 
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate or Professional) and experience running commerce on Cloud solutions.  
  • Order management, product information management and marketplace platforms 
  • B2B commerce, including complex pricing, catalogue and account structures 
  • Agentic commerce concepts and emerging standards (ACP, AP2, A2A) and practical use of AI in commerce 
  • Total cost of ownership and business case modelling 
  • The C4 model and diagrams as code 

What we can offer you

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

Permanent only
We offer a great benefits package including a discretionary bonus scheme, training opportunities, competitive pension, medical insurance, life assurance, social events, opportunities to buy and sell holidays, family friendly policies, discounts with hundreds of retailers and much more.

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

We lead with Heart, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.
We empower your Brains for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
And we champion Courage, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

 

How we use AI in the recruitment process: 
 
To ensure more focused and engaging conversations, we leverage AI in our recruitment process exclusively for secure, objective note-taking, never for evaluative judgments. This allows our team to be fully present with you. You are always welcome to request a transcript of these notes or opt out of this feature at any time. Opting out will not impact  the outcome of the interview process"

description:
As a Production Engineer, you will play a key role within our Test Engineering team, programming test software and documenting test procedures to scale production of our next-generation drone platforms. In this position, you will take ownership of verification and production test equipment, from defining test concepts to designing automated test solutions, jigs and needle-bed adapters that help us improve yield and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with our software and electronics engineers and OEM partners to enhance test coverage and reduce testing time, driving efficiency across our manufacturing process.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, agile environment, offering the opportunity to design creative, practical test solutions from concept through to mass production. This involves balancing the transition from our existing test setups to more scalable and complete solutions in a pragmatic and iterative way for a number of different projects.

Beyond test engineering, you’ll apply your software expertise across the broader hardware and software team by supporting the engineering validation efforts of new products. You will also visit OEMs to support new product integrations and support small scale engineering runs in person.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Research, design and build test solutions, including auto generated, 3D printed test equipment and CNC milled custom test jigs, and needle-bed adapters to enable low-volume prototyping and mid- to high-volume PCB production.
  • Plan and execute product verification, covering test case definition, execution, analysis, and comprehensive documentation, also for repair guidance.
  • Write Python code and STM32 firmware to test our embedded products from the inside (selftest) and outside (via test fixture).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams by offering technical guidance and hands-on support for testing and validation of advanced avionics PCBs and modular systems.
  • Specify and document additional manufacturer tests (like flying probe) to allow for a layered, holistic approach to test coverage.
  • Write Repair Guides that document the error cases and the affected components.
  • Guide manufacturers with new product integrations usually in person in the factory.
  • Manage tracking systems across multiple locations to inspect the product workflow.
  • Support internal CI systems with real hardware to validate test procedures before upgrading test fixtures at OEMs.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • Proficiency in modern Python and C/C++ also applied to embedded systems.
  • 5+ years of experience in programming software that runs on real hardware and testing it on real hardware.
  • CAD experience (e.g., Onshape) and soldering skills are required.
  • Practical experience in Linux, microcontroller programming, 3D printing, and related prototyping tools.
  • Pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Good verbal and written English communication skills.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan 
  • Car parking  
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support
  • Learning and development opportunities

We are building the leading software and electronics platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

description: Quality Assurance Associate Glasgow About the Role We are seeking a Quality Assurance Associate to support the delivery of high-quality customer due diligence and enhanced due diligence reviews. This role is responsible for conducting independent quality assessments of completed client files, ensuring they meet regulatory expectations, internal policies, and operational standards before final approval. The successful candidate will play a key role in strengthening quality controls, identifying areas for improvement, and supporting the delivery of a robust financial crime compliance framework. Key Responsibilities Conduct quality reviews of completed due diligence files, including higher-risk customers, politically exposed persons (PEPs), complex ownership structures, and individuals or entities subject to adverse media or sanctions considerations. Assess the quality and completeness of customer risk assessments, source of wealth/source of funds evidence, beneficial ownership verification, and overall case rationale. Review screening outcomes and ensure decisions, escalations, and risk-related findings are appropriately documented and supported. Capture and report quality review outcomes, categorising findings according to materiality and risk impact. Provide constructive feedback and coaching to case analysts, supporting improvements in accuracy and consistency. Monitor recurring themes and error trends, contributing to process enhancements, guidance updates, and training initiatives. Produce quality assurance reporting and management information, highlighting key metrics, trends, and areas of focus. Maintain awareness of evolving AML and financial crime regulatory requirements and ensure these are reflected within quality review standards. Assist with internal reviews, audits, regulatory enquiries, and assurance activities where required. Skills & Experience Previous experience within KYC, CDD, EDD, Financial Crime Operations, or a related compliance environment. Strong understanding of AML regulations, risk-based due diligence principles, and enhanced due diligence requirements. Experience reviewing complex client structures, source of wealth/source of funds information, and adverse media findings. Excellent attention to detail with the ability to evaluate information critically and make balanced risk-based assessments. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear and actionable feedback. Comfortable working with client lifecycle management and screening platforms. Experience within a quality control, quality assurance, oversight, or review function would be advantageous. Relevant AML, KYC, or financial crime qualifications are beneficial but not essential. How We Work: Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please use the designated space within the application questionnaire. This is a contract role-based Glasgow. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible, if your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks. For this role, a valid working permit for Singapore is mandatory. Who We Are: Delta Capita Group (a member of the Prytek Group) is a global managed services, consulting, and solutions provider with a unique combination of experience in Financial Services and technology innovation capability. Our mission is to reinvent the financial services value chain providing technology based mutualized services for financial institutions for non-differentiating services. Our 3 offerings are: Managed Services Consulting & Solutions Technology To know more about Delta Capita and our culture click here: Working at DC - Delta Capita. description: About Quandela: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation. Getting there will require several generations of intermediate architectures. Choosing the right ones means understanding what can be built, what these systems can compute and how efficiently they can do so. About this position: You will join Quandela’s Quantum Information team within Architecture, working on the evaluation and design of our near- and mid-term quantum architectures. Your role will sit between quantum theory, computational capability and real hardware constraints. You will develop methods to evaluate architecture concepts, understand their performance and limitations, and help guide future architecture choices. Depending on your background, you may draw on complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, benchmarking or related areas. You will work closely with our Device Physics, FTQC and Q.Algorithms Team. Requirements What you'll do: As a Quantum Information Scientist working on Architecture & Performance, you will: Evaluate and compare the capabilities and limitations of near- and mid-term quantum architectures. Draw on methods from complexity theory, benchmarking, characterisation and related fields to assess different architecture designs. Incorporate realistic noise, native operations and physical constraints into your analyses. Investigate when and how different architectures could provide meaningful computational capabilities or advantages. Develop scientific models and numerical tools to explore architecture-performance trade-offs. Study how architecture choices interact with algorithms, resource requirements and QEC strategies. Progressively propose and lead new research projects around architecture design and performance. You will work across our Architecture team and Algorithms and Applications team, connecting questions from the physical layer to computational capability and potential applications. - How you'll grow: During your first 3–6 months Become familiar with Quandela’s technologies, architecture roadmap and ongoing research while contributing to existing evaluation and performance studies. Within 1 year Take increasing ownership of architecture studies, compare different concepts and bring your own scientific perspective to the team. Longer term Lead exploratory research projects, propose new architecture directions and contribute to shaping Quandela’s future architecture roadmap. -- What we're looking for: We are looking for a scientist with a strong theoretical background in quantum computing, scientific autonomy and an interest in connecting different layers of the quantum-computing stack. Must-have PhD in Quantum Information, Quantum Computing, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a closely related field. Strong expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as quantum complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, performance analysis or quantum algorithms. Experience connecting theoretical or computational questions with realistic implementation, hardware or experimental constraints. Ability to assess the capabilities and limitations of quantum systems or architectures. Experience with scientific modelling, numerical simulation and Python-based scientific computing. Scientific autonomy and ability to structure open-ended research problems. Collaborative and personable, with the ability to communicate ideas clearly to people from other fields of expertise. Professional English. Important, but you can grow here Quantum Error Correction and early fault-tolerant architectures. Hardware-aware algorithm or architecture design. Quantum benchmarking and performance metrics. Noise modelling. Resource and computational-cost analysis. Collaboration with experimental or hardware-oriented quantum-computing teams. Bonus Quantum compilation or native-gate-aware circuit design. Photonic quantum computing. Resource estimation. Experience comparing quantum approaches against strong classical baselines. Previous ownership of collaborative research projects. You do not need to cover every topic above. We welcome both candidates with postdoctoral or equivalent industrial R&D experience and strong recent PhDs demonstrating scientific autonomy. Benefits Join a growing quantum-computing company and contribute directly to the research behind future generations of quantum architectures. Explore open scientific questions grounded in real hardware constraints. Work across Quantum Information, Device Physics, FTQC and Algorithms. Take ownership of broad and exploratory research projects. Contribute to the scientific directions of a growing team. Plus: Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and level of responsibility. Company savings plan. 100% health coverage through Alan. Transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus. Swile meal vouchers. Access to Gymlib. Process Talent Acquisition interview, 30–45 min Interview with Quantum Information hiring manager, 30-45 min Presentation of previous research work and discussion with members of the theory team Reference checks Technical discussion based on a scientific paper or research topic Offer For the technical exercise, you may be asked to explore scientific material outside your direct area of expertise and discuss how you would connect it to a broader architecture problem. description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships. Who We're Looking For A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product. Your Background PhD in machine learning, computer vision, robotics or a related field, with first-author publications at top venues. Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data. Experience with anomaly or novelty detection where positives are rare. Strong PyTorch and the engineering to run your own experiments at scale. Nice to Have Scene graphs, multi-object tracking or trajectory forecasting. Bayesian or probabilistic deep learning. Robotics or embodied AI. Simulation for data generation. What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence. Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: About The Role We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale. We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership. Your Mission Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives. Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls. Identity, Access & SaaS Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations. Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice. Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage. Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation. Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results. Automation & Ownership Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it. Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it. Your Profile 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering. Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM. Working knowledge of endpoint security (MDM, XDR/EDR/AV) and email / phishing defense. Practical experience securing how a company uses AI internally: shadow AI discovery, DLP for AI tools, controls for AI assistants and agents, and a working risk framework for adopting new ones. You've done this for real, not from a vendor pitch deck. Strong scripting and automation skills — you build tooling against APIs, not just configure consoles. Track record of driving improvements end-to-end and leading initiatives with little oversight. Сlear written and spoken English for engineers and leadership. Why Join Vivid? We have a hybrid model in our Limassol office, or fully remote outside office locations. We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed. Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. Fully paid vacation and sick leave. Sports compensation. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About the team:

As Senior Account Manager, you'll be a senior individual contributor and a cornerstone of our commercial team. You'll own an above-average revenue target and be expected to consistently deliver, and exceed, it. Operating with a high degree of autonomy; you'll manage complex, high-value deals end-to-end, drive forecast accuracy, and actively shape how we go to market. This role sits at the intersection of sales execution, cross-functional collaboration, and strategic influence: you'll be as comfortable building a Looker report as you are leading a high-stakes negotiation, and as effective with Finance and Product as you are in front of a customer.
